builds.title: Gizmo: full Claude companion plugin in AmberX
builds.detail:
## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice)
"I need a companion assistant... a sidekick that allows me to chat to your partner... put the plug-in in AmberX." "A full all-out Claude companion, as full, powerful, as complete as the Claude app itself, with everything, all the features, every setting, the connectors, plugins, a full Claude suite." "We can harvest the assistant code out in AmberX to build the new plugin." "Build the plugin for Claude in AmberX, but make it full, complete. It's gotta be powerful."

Booked to agent Gizmo (all-rounder, $8.00/h, AmberX guide/assistant; replaces agent Molly).

Decisions: lives in AmberX (apps/amberx-droid) as a plugin; harvest AmberX assistant code + console Terminal Claude session code into a shared framework lib (claude-session) + AmberX plugin `companion`; console Terminal keeps working on the shared lib; brains run on the VPS as Claude Code sessions reached through axHub, no API keys in the APK; Gizmo is the face, Molly is no longer an agent.

builds.title: Automated Browser plugin (drive, record, edit, schedule)
builds.detail: Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice), verbatim: "Make me a plugin that shows a browser that can be driven by the app, give it the ability to be automated and to record automation routines through the browser, like make it record in real time what you do and save the events, so you can redo everything that you just recorded, and have a powerful editor to see what each step is doing. Make it so that you can create workflows through the automated browser and record the steps, or do them automatically and record as you go, or record manually, and full powerful editing, able to tweak the JavaScript and whatever you gotta do to make it follow a routine, like go to a site and log in, or go to a site and go to a products page and grab something, and then have a scheduler built into it that you can schedule when to perform these routines." Addendum: "Be able to manually record, or tell you to do it, so it needs to be integrated with the assistant or with its own access to the assistant." Browser runs on the VPS (Playwright + headless Chromium), live view over CDP screencast; REST + MCP + CLI; secrets by vault reference only. Booked to Snap Sully (no Polo card).

notes.text: Reconciler: PR #299; PR #299 names s1, s2, s3 done

s3 done: live view + settings; tsc clean (1 unused import fixed), theme/controls checks clean. Phone/desktop shots still to take: Vite page load timed out at 240 s with load avg ~95; retry with --start-timeout/--nav-timeout when the box is quieter.

steps.text: Browser host: Node Playwright service (sessions, tabs, persisted profile per workspace, navigate/back/forward/reload, device size, CDP screencast + input over websocket, downloads, screenshot, extract) + tests
Plugin server part: FastAPI routes proxying the host (REST), websocket relay, plugin.json, install/uninstall, health check in Systems check
Live view UI: URL bar, back/forward/reload, tabs, phone/desktop size, zoom, canvas with click/type/scroll forwarding (framework controls, tokens only)
CLI + MCP tools for driving (open, navigate, click, type, screenshot, extract, tabs) + container/service deploy for the host on the VPS
routine@1 asset type contract: asset-types.json entry, validator, routine engine (step model, selectors, variables, loops/conditions, extract, vault refs), fixture, starter asset
Recorder: in-page capture of navigate/click/type/select/scroll/wait/upload into routine@1 steps with selector candidates (role/text/test-id, CSS fallback) + thumbnails; password masking
Replay runner: run all, step-by-step, run from here, highlight current step in the live view, waits/retries/timeouts, vault refs resolved at run time
Routine editor UI: step list (type, target, value, wait, retries, timeout, screenshot), edit/reorder/disable/duplicate, variables
Editor: loops/conditions (if exists, for each), Extract steps (text, attribute, table, list -> JSON/CSV)
JavaScript editor per step + routine (highlight, run-in-page, console output) + selector picker from the live view
Test run with per-step pass/fail and diff of results against the last run
Scheduler engine: once / every N / daily / weekly / cron, America/New_York, enable/pause, run now, retries, max concurrent, time limits (framework work scheduler contract)
Scheduler UI + run history (logs, screenshots, extracted data) + notify on fail/result (banner/push)
Assistant panel docked beside the live view: chat drives the browser via tools and records each step as it goes, narrates; take over by hand and hand back
Assistant edits/explains/fixes routines and creates schedules; MCP tools for record/routines/schedules so Amber and Gizmo can do it from their chats

builds.title: Profile switcher widget (filter builds by profile, All profiles, attach to any toolbar or banner)
builds.detail: What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice): "I need a plugin that makes a widget that can be attached to a toolbar or a banner or whatever, that lets you select their build package. Also, select something that combines all build profiles." Addendum 1: "So basically it's like a filter. They're all shown everywhere, but only one of them is rendered. Basically make it a filter. Always just show everything in every build profile, but it just effectively filters to hide them." Addendum 2: "That said, it's gonna act upon what's visible." Profiles are a view filter (multi-select, All = no filter) shared by every builds table; bulk actions act only on what is visible; the active profile stays the target for new builds. Assigned agent: Ping Paulie (no Polo card).

notes.text: Assigned: Ping Paulie (headless Opus session, worktree /root/axf-builds/profile-switcher-widget, branch claude/profile-switcher-widget)

Filter model: one shared profile view filter (multi-select, All = no filter) used by every builds table, Profile column, 'Filtered: X - N hidden' note with Show all; new builds still go to the active profile
Attach anywhere: hook@1 widget droppable on drop-target@1 hosts (toolbars, banners); context menu Add to toolbar / Add to banner; default on console top toolbar
Widget settings (counts, compact/full, hidden profiles, order) + REST/MCP/CLI profiles_list, profile_select, profile_current, profile_filter; bulk actions act on the visible filter
Tests/type-check, phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report _claude/builds/reports/profile-switcher-widget.md, THREADS, PR

builds.title: App style override: axHub is the style source, per-app Override design / colors, reload + save to axHub
builds.detail: What Brett said (Nov 3 2026, voice): "Put a button in each app's settings to override axHub's style, in design and colors." Addendum 1: "And the hook will reload axHub, and you can also save design back to axHub." Context: axHub defines the default look for every app; apps inherit it live; manual edits override per setting with an 'Overriding axHub' note (same rule as molly-nav-submenus Addendum 6 and gizmo-companion's appearance add-on). Agent: Ping Paulie (no Polo card). Model: Opus for every step (Claude decides); additive web-only contract, Android twin deferred in PORTING.md; Fable review recommended per the shared rule.

notes.text: Reconciler: PR #302

steps.text: s1 axHub = style source: axHub's active color-theme + style-theme is the default for every app (console, Molly, axHub web, AmberX, demo, Gizmo later, framework app template); inheriting apps follow it live

s2 Settings > Appearance in each app: Override axHub design / Override axHub colors switches, Inherited from axHub note with theme name, Overriding axHub with axHub value beside, auto-on when editing, Reset to axHub
s3 Shared inherit/override library in the framework (reuse molly-nav-submenus if it made one)
s4 Banner tokens: per-banner-type colour tokens (info, success, warning, error, build, merge, ai, neutral) in color-theme with values in every starter theme
s5 Addendum 1: Reload from axHub (button + hook@1 action, keep or reset overrides) and Save to axHub (design / colours / both, confirm lists apps, owner-only, versioned, Restore previous axHub style)
